title: Alice Scully says photos of the Aztec crash still exist

tellings.quote: she told him that there were definitely photos of the Aztec crash still in existence.

plain: Photographs of the Aztec crash, a flying saucer said to have come down near Aztec, New Mexico, in 1948, still exist. A woman named Alice Scully told this to a man named Chris Evans, and Scott Ramsey, who has spent years investigating the Aztec case, repeats it to Michels. If true, there would be pictures of the crash someone has kept hidden.
